usage: corvint-console [-addr HOST:PORT] [-repo DIR] [-specs DIR] [-tasks FILE] [-snapshot FILE]
                       [-stable-artifact-root DIR] [-timeout D]
Serve the loopback-only Corvint Console for one repository (-repo, default the working directory);
a non-loopback -addr is refused and any positional argument is refused before anything starts.
Example: corvint-console -repo /absolute/repo -addr 127.0.0.1:7777
--addr: loopback address to bind; a non-loopback address is refused
--atm: legacy alias for -tasks
--repo: repository to administer
--snapshot: the corvint-dashboard-snapshot executable the evidence pane invokes
--specs: repository holding docs/specs and the tree the code pane reads (default: -repo)
--stable-artifact-root: artifact root for the chain pane's verified cem/1.0 mode; a stable chain is then drawn only on a stable verifier ACCEPT against the request's base
--tasks: the Corvint Tasks executable to invoke
--timeout: per-invocation timeout for corvint-tasks, git and the snapshot compiler; the snapshot is the slowest source and may need longer on a loaded host
usage: corvint-console [-addr HOST:PORT] [-repo DIR] [-specs DIR] [-tasks FILE] [-snapshot FILE] [-stable-artifact-root DIR] [-timeout D] [--addr VALUE] [--atm VALUE] [--repo VALUE] [--snapshot VALUE] [--specs VALUE] [--stable-artifact-root VALUE] [--tasks VALUE] [--timeout VALUE]
